summary: Eight metres of kerb at a junction with a painted island; too short.
reasons: Only 8 m, shorter than a van
Junction island, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the east, but a house sits about 15 m to the west at the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the edge of a painted traffic island at a bend junction; a van would sit in or beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street junction; motorway noise from the east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars; junction markings only.

sun_shade: Open junction with bush shade from the east.
